data.long_meaning: Derived from the Hebrew name 'Adam', meaning 'man'. The suffix '-nah' is of uncertain origin but may mean 'comfort' or 'grace'. In the Bible, Eve is the first woman created and is the mother of all humanity. Adaminah could thus be interpreted as 'Eve's daughter' or 'graceful comfort'. The name Adaminah carries the meaning “Eve's daughter” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Adaminah usually hope their child will grow to embody eve's daughter and live with faith, good character and purpose.
